title: This Note Made Him Rich
description:
Marlo waited all day for one package. He stepped out for two minutes, and came back to a note: Sorry we missed you.

Watch how one missed delivery turned into a million-dollar idea, the December box mountain that nearly buried it, and why MegaSock's robot lockers couldn't compete.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).
